test_title: PYST 30: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 24 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

A. at the same time giving happiness to the poor

B. by providing them with food, clothes, money or grain

C. festivals in India are celebrated to share happiness

D. by being in the presence of the members of the family and
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (4)** i.e. **CDAB**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject "Festivals in India," which is correctly indicated by **part (C).**** **
 
• Following the subject, "are celebrated to share happiness," **(C)** continues the logical sequence, making it clear what the festivals are for.
 
• **The next part,** "by being in the presence of the members of the family and," continues the statement by explaining how happiness is shared, indicated by (D).
 
• **Ending with,** "at the same time giving happiness to the poor by providing them with food, clothes, money or grain" (ABD) completes the sentence by stating the inclusive aspect of festivals in India.

Therefore, the correct answer is **CDAB.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (ACBD):** This option starts with "at the same time giving happiness to the poor by providing them with food, clothes, money or grain." This sequence does not appropriately introduce the subject or flow smoothly.
 
• **Option 2 (CBAD):** This option starts with "festivals in India are celebrated to share happiness by being in the presence of the members of the family and," which places the method before the explanation.
 
• **Option 3 (CABD):** This option disrupts the logical sequence, making the sentence unclear.
